add.event: 州长凯里签署法案，给予纽约市23亿美元救命资金，足够支撑三个月
add.evidence: On September 9, 1975, Governor Carey signed a bill giving the city a $2.3 billion lifeline, enough to subsidize the city for three months.

add.event: 福特总统宣布拒绝对纽约市纾困
add.evidence: On October 29, 1975, President Ford announced that he would refuse to grant the city a bailout.

add.event: 财政保守派民主党人郭德华当选市长
add.evidence: A fiscal conservative, Democrat Ed Koch, was elected as mayor in 1977.

add.event: 纽约市不再需要市政援助公司支持，该公司投票解散
add.evidence: By 1985, the City no longer needed the support of the Municipal Assistance Corporation, which voted itself out of existence.
